faqs.q: Is LinkedIn useful for small businesses?
faqs.a: Yes, especially for businesses that sell to other businesses or to professionals. LinkedIn lets small business owners reach decision-makers directly, build credibility by sharing useful content and generate leads through relationships, often without spending money on ads at the start.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a LinkedIn profile and a LinkedIn Company Page?
faqs.a: A LinkedIn profile represents you as an individual and is used for personal networking and thought leadership. A Company Page represents your business, where you share company updates, job openings and industry news with followers. Most businesses do best when the owner's profile and the Company Page support each other.

faqs.q: How often should a business post on LinkedIn?
faqs.a: Consistency matters more than volume, so choose a posting schedule you can keep up week after week. Focus on useful content such as industry insights, how-to tips and client success stories, and spend time replying to comments and engaging with others' posts as well.

faqs.q: Are LinkedIn ads worth it for lead generation?
faqs.a: They can be, if you need faster results than organic posting gives. LinkedIn ads let you target people by factors such as job role, industry and company, which suits B2B lead generation. Start with a small budget, test different formats and track the leads you actually receive before spending more.
